catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class returns a motion plan without executing it. The manipulation and motion classes command motion. This package only asks niryo_moveit/MoverService for four planned trajectories and executes nothing, so it uses an x-cap id with an inline schema. The action verb is invoke. The ROS binding operation stays read because the service returns trajectories only.
catalogue_requests.summary: Plan the tutorial's four Niryo pick-and-place trajectories with its MoveIt service; never execute them.

That RESULT.json was moved aside and is not this passing record. The old review paragraph was not copied.

SCOPE. x-cap.unity-technologies.niryo_pick_place_plan.v1 calls service /niryo_moveit of type niryo_moveit/MoverService (mover.py:128 and the import at :21; source_name niryo_moveit). The callback plans four trajectories and returns them: pre-grasp (mover.py:81), grasp (mover.py:90-92), pick-up (mover.py:100), place (mover.py:108), then appends those four (mover.py:113-117). Start angles are req.joints_input.joints (mover.py:78), float64[6] (NiryoMoveitJoints.msg:1), already radians. This package does not convert degrees. The grasp stage lowers a copy of the pick pose by 0.05 m inside the callback (mover.py:91). That edit is not a command of this package and the fake does not apply it. Output executed is const false. An empty trajectories list is a successful ROS return (mover.py:84-85 and the empty returns at :94-95, :102-103, :110-111) and a failed receipt here (MHS.CAPABILITY.OUTPUT_INVALID), because the output contract requires four plans. A plan() the callback treats as false (mover.py:48-53) is a failed receipt with no output.

STOP. Verb invoke, exclusive. The ROS binding operation is read: MoverService.srv:1-5 answers trajectories only, and an effectful ROS surface without an acknowledged stop would leave e-stop unreached. The software latch is the whole stop (estop kind software, native null). There is no unpause and no re-enable. A request already sent is not awaited. Tests show an e-stop completes while a silent plan is in flight (deadline_ms 2000, elapsed under 1.5 s) and that in-flight receipt is not completed, and that a latched e-stop refuses the next plan with MHS.SAFETY.ESTOP_ENGAGED and sends no call.

NOT COVERED. Unity starts ExecuteTrajectories only for the response to its own request (TrajectoryPlanner.cs:147-152) and writes joint targets after Rad2Deg, closing the gripper at the grasp index (TrajectoryPlanner.cs:171-207). A plan returned on rosbridge does not start that coroutine. The arm, the gripper, the ROS-TCP endpoint (part_3.launch:5-7, port 10000), the /niryo_joints publisher (SourceDestinationPublisher.cs:18) and sim_real_pnp.py are not bound. sim_real_pnp subscribes to topic sim_real_pnp (sim_real_pnp.py:173), sends goals to action niryo_one/commander/robot_action (sim_real_pnp.py:123-124) and uses PICK_PLACE_HEIGHT_OFFSET 0.065 (sim_real_pnp.py:41), which is not the callback's 0.05 m. The submodule niryo_one_ros is not cited. The MoveGroupCommander is a local of the callback (mover.py:75-76). rospy.spin only waits (mover.py:130) and does not serialise service callbacks, so another client of /niryo_moveit can overlap this callback, each with its own commander, both talking to the shared move_group node. Plan only while Unity is not calling the service. Exclusive covers this endpoint's locally active invocations. A deadline or an e-stop does not retire a plan already sent, so remote planning can continue and overlap the next request.

RISK. R0, the card floor (task.json risk_floor R0, expected_mode simulated). The bound endpoint is the planning service. This package publishes no joint command and no cmd_vel. demo.launch passes simulation_mode true (demo.launch:5-7). move_group.launch still defaults allow_trajectory_execution to true and fake_execution to false (move_group.launch:15-16); the callback only calls plan().

LIMITS. Joint indexes 0, 1, 3, 4 and 5 use the xacro property pairs (niryo_one.urdf.xacro:39-42 and :45-50). Elbow index 2 is operator_required: the lower property is -1.397485 (xacro:43) and the upper is the expression ${PI/2} (xacro:44). The file sets PI to 3.14159265359 (xacro:37). The gate does not evaluate ${PI/2}, so that upper is not recorded as a sourced number. Pose position and orientation components are operator_required. site-limits.example.json is an example overlay, including an elbow max of 1.570796326795 (the operator's 3.14159265359/2), labeled as an example. demo.launch sets /move_group/start_state_max_bounds_error to 0.3 (demo.launch:19-21). This package does not add 0.3 to the URDF travel. A non-finite number and a quaternion whose norm is below 1e-6 are refused with MHS.CAPABILITY.INPUT_INVALID before the service is called.

LICENCE. The lock and the card stay Apache-2.0 (LICENSE.md:3, niryo_moveit/package.xml:10). The SRDF file header says GNU GPL version 3 (niryo_one.srdf:8-11). That header is disclosed and is not the package licence recorded in the lock.
